purpose: Teach: 魅せ/お粗末/下品/愕然/幾分/すわっ/ふみ/成り行き

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが歌で皆を魅せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to enchant everyone with a song.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight lift at the end—pleased anticipation. Speaking to a child with the tone of someone sharing something she thinks he'll love.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お粗末な絵だけどお父さんに渡したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I gave Dad a drawing. It's not very good, but I gave it to him.
lines.style: Quiet pride mixed with self-doubt. Brief pause after 'drawing'—checking himself. Spoken carefully, wanting approval but not pushing for it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、下品な言葉を真似しないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't repeat the rough words you hear, okay?
lines.style: Gentle correction, not scolding. Soft firmness—the kind of boundary a caring adult sets without making the child feel small. Calm and steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの誕生日サプライズに愕然とされたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad was really surprised by the birthday surprise we planned.
lines.style: Eager, quiet excitement. Small pause before 'surprised'—savoring the memory. Speaking like he's sharing a secret he's been holding onto.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは幾分疲れてらっしゃるみたい
lines.en: Sho, your dad seems a bit tired lately.
lines.style: Gentle observation, thoughtful. Speaking more to herself than to him—noticing something she's been turning over. No alarm, just quiet care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの隣にすわっておしゃべりしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I sat next to Dad and we talked for a while.
lines.style: Soft contentment. Straightforward, no hurry. Speaking like he's offering her something quiet—the gift of having done the right thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが日記をふみ続けてらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad keeps writing in his diary every day.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost musing. Slight warmth—she's noticed something about his father that speaks to his character. Reflective, steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんを信じて成り行きを見守るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to trust Dad and just see how things unfold.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No hesitation—he's made up his mind. Spoken with the gravity of a child who's chosen the harder, better path. Small and sure.
